notes.title: Improved Local Co-Op Option, Chinese language Fixes & Discord QR Update
notes.notes:
What’s new:

• Added a checkbox in the settings to enable local multiplayer using Keyboard/Mouse + Controller → (See image below for updated controls) 
• Fixed an issue where Chinese characters would disappear 
• Updated default settings to launch the game in 120 FPS & high quality 
• Fixed the QR code not appearing in the main menu → Now links directly to our Discord server upon clicking.
• Small collision bug fixes


Thanks again for playing Wires and Whiskers and for all your feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update – Localization Support, Checkpoint Saves
notes.notes:
We’ve released a small update to improve usability and accessibility!
---
 🈯 Localization Menu
- Players can now switch between supported languages

- Language changes apply immediately without restart


💾 Checkpoint Saves (New)
- Game now saves progress at key checkpoints

- If you quit or fail, you’ll restart from your last checkpoint

- Helps streamline retry flow without losing full progress


🔧 Other Tweaks
- Minor improvements to settings UI

- Small performance optimizations





Let us know on Discord if you notice any bugs or have feedback about the new systems!

notes.title: Minor Update – QR Menu, Remote Play Improvements, A/D Support
notes.notes:
We’ve pushed a small update based on your feedback!
What’s new:
- Added a **QR code** on the main menu for quick Discord access

- Improved **Steam Remote Play Together** support (more reliable controller detection)

- You can now use **A/D keys** to switch characters on the selection screen (for keyboard users)



Note: Keyboard play is still designed around a single player using **mouse + keyboard**, but A/D now gives you more flexibility if you still want to use only the keyboard.


Fixes & Optimizations:
- Fixed various minor bugs

- Optimized main menu performance
